Placebo windows: fake before = first h, fake after = last h years of the before window, h = years // 2 (Denver's 5-year window drops its middle year). Hand-check corrections of the real before window are split between the halves in proportion to the raw homes in each half (duplicates 0).
Placebo: stops keep their real line-age class (not re-dated to the fake reform year).
Placebo interval: 2,000 draws resampling the held-out places' placebo predictions (the pooled = their mean).

Upzoned share (A): the in-district (in_reform_area) share of the land acres of the place's reform stops' 1/4-mile lots; a cell's training share = place-equal mean of that share over the cell's stops (comparison stops have 0 in every D-11 place).

Unknown line age (A and B): every stop T2b excludes (4-9 years old, opened after the after window, unknown year) takes the training mix = place-equal mean of the training places' acre-weighted new-line share of classified reform acres (about 0.46).

Distance (A): band shares are the place's reform stops' 1/4-mile land acres within 1/8 mile (201 m) vs 1/8-1/4; the ratio is the 0-1/8 over 1/8-1/4 effect averaged over the two cell contrasts (old, new) of the training 2x2.

B: not stated in the lock, chosen as the stored models: each place the same total weight in each window, lots equal within a place; the Milwaukee Hop lots are in B's training as new-line, not-rezoned lots (as in the 2x2 main); lots on excluded-age stops are left out of B's fit and take the training mix when predicted; the outcome is homes in the window and predictions are divided by the window's years.

B: the locked toggle (upzoned as observed minus upzoned = 0, at the after-window level) also switches off the upzoned main term (the before-reform level gap); a difference-in-differences reading (after toggle minus before toggle, per year) is reported beside, not tiered.

Stored models: errors scored against the current measured effects; the random forest file is from the older data state (before the land and hand-check fixes). Stop models: place totals from tod_optiond_stopmodel_places.csv. Double ML: in-area treatment, seed 1. No stored model has a placebo run, so their tier is by the rule only.
Wisconsin translation of a method = mean of its 11 held-out predictions x 298.97 (4,874.1 / 100 x 5 x 1.2269; the plain average gives 33.54 -> 10,028).
Milwaukee Hop beside: the 2x2 cell version only (B needs stop line ages and reform lots; not run for the Hop).

Madison beside: its station-area lot table has no after-window homes and no comparison stops, so the measured station-area effect cannot be built; A's prediction is set beside the overlay test (different design, short window).
